mission.title: Moving Target
mission.description: Pick up important intel from a Bluepill.

phase.briefing:
Greetings, friend of Zion. We need your help to recover data from a couple Bluepills who were previously watched by Agents. Both of them have information about an aspect of the Matrix we desperately need intel on.
We need you to go to their locations, meet them and receive a piece of data from each. Once you have all of the data, you will upload them through a hardline.

enter.say: Get the Access Codes from Gary Novak per Tyndall's request.

objective.text: Get the access codes from Gary Novak

phase.briefing: Be on the watch for Exiles attackers. Any programs you run into during this data extraction are probably against our efforts.

enter.say: I'm detecting additional forces on the premises. We still need to locate Linda Ortega, but be on the look out for hostiles.

objective.text: Pick up the data from Linda Ortega

phase.briefing: I'm going over the information that you've found so far. All I'm getting out of this is a name and an address. We'll need you to investigate this. The address is being sent to you now.

enter.say: I hope that this is your final stop. We're looking for a Mr. Paul Whitley. Speak with him and pick up any data that he might have for you.

objective.text: Get the last piece of information from Paul Whitley and the filing cabinet
Get the last piece of information from Paul Whitley and the filing cabinet
Upload all data through a hardline
